about: Terminal agents a company's people can move to, and which seat or plan already pays for each. Each row names the page it was read from and the day. rule = a per-program rule gatecall enforces (copy_only_prepaid, training_only, no_blanket_permission).

agents.name: Claude Code
agents.included_in: Claude Pro, Max, Team (Standard and Premium seats), Enterprise; or an Anthropic Console API key
agents.company_seat: Claude Team Standard or Premium, Enterprise
agents.note: Remote Control, cloud sessions and teleport need a claude.ai sign-in; an API key or a custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL turns Remote Control off.

agents.name: Codex CLI
agents.included_in: ChatGPT Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, Enterprise
agents.free_path: ChatGPT Free (limited); Codex with an OpenRouter key

agents.name: Antigravity CLI (successor of Gemini CLI)
agents.included_in: Google AI Pro and Ultra (Gemini CLI stopped serving them on 18.06.2026); Gemini CLI stays served on Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licences
agents.company_seat: Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise (Gemini CLI); Workspace with Google AI plans

agents.name: Gemini CLI
agents.included_in: Gemini Code Assist Standard ($19/$22.80) and Enterprise ($45/$54) licences, Google Cloud
agents.company_seat: Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise

agents.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
agents.included_in: All GitHub Copilot plans ("All plans include Copilot CLI"): Free, Pro, Business $19, Enterprise $39

agents.name: Grok Build
agents.included_in: SuperGrok and X Premium+ (since 25.05.2026; v1.0 on 07.08.2026); no stand-alone plan

agents.name: Muse Code
agents.included_in: Muse Code plans $5 / $15 / $50 a month, or pay per token (Muse Spark 1.x $1.25/$4.25 per 1M)

agents.name: Kiro CLI
agents.included_in: Kiro Free (50 credits), Pro $20 (1,000), Pro+ $40 (2,000), Power $200 (10,000); extra credits $0.04

agents.name: Cursor CLI
agents.included_in: Cursor plans; Teams Standard $40 per user ($32 billed yearly), Teams Premium $120 ($96)

agents.name: OpenCode
agents.included_in: Free program; the company brings a key (z.ai GLM measured 4 of 6 tasks on 27.09.2026)

agents.name: Qwen Code
agents.included_in: Free program; Alibaba Token Plan Team $20/$75/$200 per seat for people; the free OAuth tier ended on 15.04.2026
agents.free_path: a local model or an OpenRouter free model

agents.name: Kimi Code (kimi)
agents.included_in: Kimi membership $19-199 (personal development only); Kimi Business $600 a year per seat, from 2

agents.name: Goose
agents.included_in: Free program; the company brings a model key or a local model

agents.name: aider + Groq
agents.included_in: Free program; Groq free tier 1,000 requests a day (aider + Groq measured 4 of 4 tasks on 27.09.2026)

agents.name: sidecall (Claude Code plugin)
agents.included_in: Free; asks the agents already installed (Codex, Antigravity, Grok, Kimi) the same question through their own subscriptions

agents.name: roundcall (Claude Code plugin)
agents.included_in: Free; one question to the AI chat sites the person is already signed in to, through their own Chrome
